item_short_desc: Are you a sheep or a sheepdog? Rothco's Sheep Dog Patch features a hook back and embroidered Sheep Dog Patch image and text.
description: Are you a sheep or a sheepdog? Rothco's Sheep Dog Patch features a hook back and embroidered Sheep Dog Patch image and text; The Sheepdog patch represents those that protect people (the sheep) from evil (the wolves). The patches are designed with a hook backing which makes it ideal for attaching to our Special Ops Jackets, Transport Packs, Tactical Vest and more. Patches with the item #’s starting with ‘P’ are individually packaged with a header card.
